title: Show HN: PS2 games statically recompiled to WebAssembly
summary: A Show HN project that statically recompiles PlayStation 2 games into WebAssembly, enabling them to run in a web browser. The GitHub repository provides the tooling and approach for translating PS2 binaries ahead-of-time rather than emulating them dynamically, drawing significant community interest with 303 points and 156 comments on Hacker News.
